verdict.rationale: Plaid Link is documented as the drop-in client-side component users interact with to link their accounts, so the developer does not build institution UI [plaid-docs-5]. Its flow can be customized from the Dashboard without code [plaid-docs-11], and community reports describe the in-app bank search and 'link manually' fallback, corroborating a ready-made hosted widget [plaid-comm-9, plaid-comm-10]. A public_token is shown as the artifact representing a linked Item [plaid-docs-14], and the Quickstart demonstrates the end-to-end integration [plaid-docs-10]. missing for 10: explicit evidence of server-side session (link_token) creation, documentation of the public_token-to-access_token exchange in the production flow (the pack only shows public_token via a Sandbox endpoint), and independent hands-on corroboration of the full create-open-exchange sequence.
